database.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 18.6 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

fixture.seed_sql:
INSERT INTO users(id,username) SELECT md5('author-'||i)::uuid,'author-'||i FROM generate_series(1,20) i;
INSERT INTO posts(id,author_id,slug,title,excerpt,content,content_html,content_render_version,updated_at,deleted_at)
SELECT md5('post-'||i)::uuid, md5('author-'||(i%20+1))::uuid, 'article-'||i,
       '文章标题 '||i, '正文摘要 '||i,
       '# 标题 '||i||E'\n\n'||repeat(md5(i::text)||' 实际博客正文，包含中文段落与 Markdown。'||E'\n',80)
       || CASE WHEN i%137=0 THEN ' 特定关键词 TargetNeedle ' ELSE '' END,
       '',1,now()-i*interval '1 second',CASE WHEN i%10=0 THEN now()-i*interval '1 second' END
FROM generate_series(1,10000) i;
INSERT INTO pages(id,slug,title,content,content_html,content_render_version,updated_at,deleted_at)
SELECT md5('page-'||i)::uuid,'page-'||i,'页面标题 '||i,
       '# 页面 '||i||E'\n\n'||repeat(md5(i::text)||' 中文页面正文。'||E'\n',80)
       || CASE WHEN i%137=0 THEN ' 特定关键词 TargetNeedle ' ELSE '' END,
       '',1,now()-i*interval '1 second',CASE WHEN i%10=0 THEN now()-i*interval '1 second' END
FROM generate_series(1,5000) i;
ANALYZE posts; ANALYZE pages; ANALYZE users;
fixture.description: UTF-8 Chinese Markdown with an 80-paragraph repeated body per document; PostgreSQL can compress these bodies. Article average 7,055 bytes and page average 4,415 bytes. Search targets occur every 137 documents.

reproduction: Create a fresh, dedicated loopback test database; never reuse a business database.
Apply migrations/postgres/0001_initial_schema.sql through 0004_comment_moderation.sql, then execute fixture.seed_sql and analyze tables.
In a new psql session execute sql.before to capture EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS before adding indexes.
Apply 0005_content_admin_search_indexes.sql, then in a new psql session execute sql.after. Repeat with SET plan_cache_mode=force_generic_plan in the same session.

For write cost, run sql.update_cost five times; every sample uses BEGIN/ROLLBACK. To reproduce the before sample, omit the new indexes. Index build timing uses psql timing against the same seeded database.

limits: Single local EXPLAIN measurements for reads on synthetic data; not production latency, throughput or SLA.
Read plans were predominantly buffer hits. Repeated synthetic paragraphs compress well; more diverse or much longer Markdown can increase storage, decompression and index-build costs.

Body update samples measure one SQL UPDATE only, excluding rendering, relationship synchronization, audit and network round trips. GIN fastupdate remains at its default, so these samples do not include all amortized pending-list cleanup costs.
GIN and ordering indexes add write and migration cost. CREATE INDEX runs inside the forward migration transaction; deployments should follow the documented stop-write upgrade sequence.

Search retains per-field lower/strpos semantics, including literal %, underscore, backslash and Chinese substrings. Queries without three consecutive alphanumeric characters skip the trigram candidate predicate and retain scanning.
Page-number and total-count contracts remain intact. OFFSET still scales with the skipped rows; sampled offsets of 8,000 posts and 4,000 pages did not justify changing the public pagination contract.
